hypotheses.reasoning: payment-svc v1.10.0 rolled out at 02:16:24. Afterwards its /charge responses return keys id, state and updatedAt instead of the required status field. order-service can't decode them and returns 502, which api-gateway passes on as 502 on /checkout. The account-svc to auth-svc ECONNREFUSED errors affect /login only. The billing-reconciler checksum errors come from old archive partitions. The DLQ message at #630 is a single message. All three are unrelated.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back payment-svc to v1.9.1, or fix the /charge response contract so it includes status. Then check the auth-svc outage affecting /login separately.
